{{Top|leg}}
'''Shol'Arma''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Shol'Arma commented on the entry for the [[Leviathan Power Armor]], stating that unless the wearer was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], they would have trouble wearing it. To counter that, Shol'Arma suggested having an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] record the wearer swimming so they could map the movements into the Leviathan's motion control programming.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
